data.summary: Reviews appear authentic with clear patterns of both satisfaction and dissatisfaction. Long-term customers praise reliability and proactive service, while newer customers report communication issues and questionable repair practices. The Angi perfect rating is suspicious given the detailed negative experiences on Google.
fake_signals: Angi's perfect 5.0 with only 7 reviews contrasts sharply with Google's detailed mixed reviews

negative_evidence: Alleged misdiagnosis of heater to justify expensive replacement
positive_evidence: Proactive winterizing service mentioned by multiple customers

authentic_signals: Varied writing styles and specific complaints
Mix of praise and constructive criticism in 3-star review
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (3.6) and Angi (5.0). Google reviews show mixed experiences, while Angi shows perfect score with few reviews.

reviews.text: Asked for a quote to repair our pool heater. The quote they gave me was $6000 to replace because they told me it was not available anymore and could not get parts any longer. This was a lie as my pool heater (Less than five years old) was still available and all the parts to it. It ended up being a $12 repair because mice had eaten the copper wires inside. Buyer beware!!
reviews.author: Mary Nancy Wiley

reviews.text: Tadpole pools has been taking care of my pool for about 4 -5 years now.  They do a wonderful job of maintaining everything.  Their prices are fair.  Their communication with their customers needs improvement otherwise it would have been 5 stars.  But when the time comes that you need answers they came through for me.
reviews.author: Randy Rekerdres

reviews.text:
This is what you get when you rely on Tadpole pools to take care of your swimming pool.

We bought a house recently and Tadpole was the pool company that had been taking care of the pool, so we thought we'd give them a try.   Unfortunately, they've been extremely unreliable and their support has been non-existent.

We've not seen our pool tech in two weeks and this is the result.  I've called their office and emailed their support team to let them know the pool wasn't looking good and was told "your tech is a little behind".  We were promised someone by the end of the week, yet nobody came and no phone call to explain what they planned to do.

They frequently just don't show up for scheduled maintenance days, don't communicate when they plan to make up service, etc.
This is the second time (and last) they've let our pool / hot tub get out or control.

There are a lot of good pool service companies in the DFW area, these guys don't seem to be one of them.  Save yourself some frustration and look elsewhere.
reviews.author: Tobe Thompson

reviews.text:
Won't the impending doom.  I went to look at how to insulate my pool equipment.   Tadpole proactively did it for me.   They went as far as to put a cover on my faucet used
For autofill.   Good guys responsive to questions.
reviews.author: justin ripp

reviews.text: I've had nothing but great experience with Tadpole for years. They proactively winterize our equipment before hard freezes and have been hugely responsive even off-hours when we've had any issues. Prices for their services are also fair and competitive for the area.
reviews.author: Ann Marie Navar

reviews.text:
Tadpole is fabulous. They've been servicing my pool for 5+ years.  The water is always perfect. Occasionally I will check the water with my own test kit, everything is where it should be. They arrive reliably once a week and they always close gates behind them.

I really appreciate the fact they are excellent communicators, most of the time the phone is answered by a human. When I do leave a message I get a call back within one hour.

Pleasant and knowledgeable people.
reviews.author: SatelliteGalaxy

reviews.text: Our family has used tadpole pools for almost a decade and we are very pleased with their expertise and customer service.  The owner is ABSOLUTELY hands on and has always been extremely responsive and accessible.  He is involved at the state level with industry regulations and standards, and even donates time to water safety education in schools across the metroplex.  Our service technician is AMAZING.  I have his cell number and he always responds immediately, even on weekends...and has for years.  Their customer service from a repair/replacement standpoint is unparalleled.  Just yesterday our filter pump was making a funny noise.  I alerted our technician, who made a special same day house call and reported the issue to their service team, who showed up within 24 hours to diagnose and replace the part.  I could go on and on, but my experiences are always consistent and always exceed my expectations.  Thank you Tadpole Pools!
reviews.author: Shelley Moore

reviews.text: Tadpole pools service is single handily the best pool service. They always respond in minutes of my requests. They help with even the smallest things, and are very helpful and hardworking. We have used them for 8+ years!
reviews.author: Winn M
